## What changed and why

Describe the problem, resulting behavior, and scope. Label proposals explicitly.

## Related issues

Link an issue or RFC. Use closing keywords only when this PR completes that work.

## Implications

- Architecture / protocol:
- Security / privacy:
- Compatibility / genomic semantics:

Use `Not applicable` with a reason where appropriate.

## Validation

List actual checks and results. At bootstrap, include Markdown, link and asset
render checks. Do not imply automated tests or CI exist. For future code, include
relevant correctness and failure-path tests and reproducibility details.

## Known limitations

Describe unresolved questions, risks, and follow-up work.

## Checklist

- [ ] I read CONTRIBUTING.md and follow the Code of Conduct.
- [ ] I have the right to contribute this material and retained required notices.
- [ ] I included no secrets, sensitive metadata, or identifiable patient genomic data.
- [ ] Documentation, diagrams, status and roadmap reflect the change where relevant.
- [ ] Implemented behavior, proposed behavior, assumptions and evidence are distinguished.
- [ ] I described the checks actually performed and any checks not available.
